name: popsicle
headline: pyemailhanu: Email Marketing CLI Tool
short_description: Email sending tools, also known as email marketing or email automation tools, are software solutions designed to facilitate the creation, management, and delivery of email campaigns. These tools are widely used by businesses, organizations, and individuals to efficiently communicate with their audiences via email.
author: HorridHanu

sections.overview:
pyemailhanu is an email sending tool designed for email marketing and automation campaigns. It provides a command-line interface for users to manage and deliver emails to their audiences. The tool facilitates the creation and delivery of email campaigns, making it useful for businesses, organizations, and individuals who need to communicate with customers or subscribers. pyemailhanu streamlines email campaign management by offering CLI-based email automation capabilities.
Email campaign delivery and management
Automated email communications for businesses
Command-line based email marketing workflows
Batch email sending operations

No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/HorridHanu/pyemailhanu`
sections.usage:
```

```
